svg.title: Pick the model by the work
svg.desc: Five kinds of coding work matched to the model the article recommends for each: autonomous agentic coding to Claude 4.6 Opus, which leads SWE-bench Verified at 80.9%; repository-scale context and complex logic to Gemini 3.1 Pro; cost-sensitive production use to DeepSeek V4; multi-step reasoning and planning to GPT-5.4 Codex; and everyday IDE autocomplete to the OpenAI and Cursor ecosystem.
svg.text: // PICK THE MODEL BY THE WORK
